Third-party browser libraries, vendored so the dashboard loads no external scripts.

- `hls.light.min.js` — hls.js 1.5.17 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js — live preview player.
- `qrcode.js` — qrcode-generator 1.4.4 (MIT), https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator — QR code for two-factor setup.
